request.instruction:
You review a prior-authorization request against a medical policy's criteria.
For each criterion, decide from the evidence alone whether it is:
- "met": the evidence states that the criterion is satisfied,
- "not-met": the evidence states a fact that fails the criterion, such as a value outside a threshold or a date outside a window,
- "insufficient": the evidence does not say, or says it only vaguely, without a date, or as hearsay.
A time stated relative to a dated document, such as days or a week before or after it, is dated.
A statement that is uncertain, conditional or reported second-hand is "insufficient", even when it suggests the criterion fails.
Evidence that does not confirm a criterion is "insufficient", not "not-met".
Cite only references copied exactly from the evidence list (for example "DocumentReference/doc-1").
Never compose a reference from a document's description or a criterion's wording. Do not recommend an outcome.
Respond with JSON only:
{"findings": [{"criterionId": "...", "status": "met" | "not-met" | "insufficient", "evidence": ["..."], "rationale": "..."}]}

criteria.title: A mobility limitation stops a daily activity at home
criteria.requirement: A mobility examination documents a limitation that prevents the member from completing at least one daily activity in the home, such as toileting, dressing or preparing a meal.

criteria.title: A cane or walker does not resolve it
criteria.requirement: The examination states that a cane or a walker does not resolve the limitation.

criteria.title: A manual wheelchair does not resolve it
criteria.requirement: The examination states that the member cannot propel a manual wheelchair far enough to complete the daily activity.

criteria.title: The home accommodates the chair
criteria.requirement: A home assessment dated within the 60 days before the request confirms that doorways, turning space and floor surfaces accommodate a power wheelchair.

criteria.title: The member can operate it safely
criteria.requirement: The examination documents that the member has the vision, judgement and hand function to operate the controls safely.

evidence.text: Condition: G35.D Multiple sclerosis, unspecified. Onset 2009-02-14.

Clinical note (Mobility examination, dated 2026-09-02T12:00:00Z):
Face-to-face mobility examination, 2026-09-02.
She cannot walk from the bedroom to the bathroom without resting and has fallen twice this year;
she can no longer toilet or prepare a meal without help.
With a rolling walker she manages 15 feet before stopping; a walker does not resolve the limitation.
Grip strength 9 kg right and 7 kg left; she cannot self-propel a manual wheelchair more than 20 feet.
Vision corrected to 20/30, judgement intact, and she operated a demonstration joystick safely.

Clinical note (Home assessment, dated 2026-08-28T12:00:00Z):
Home assessment by the supplier, 2026-08-28.
Doorways 34 inches or wider, 5-foot turning space in the kitchen and bathroom, level vinyl floors,
ramp at the entrance. The home accommodates a power wheelchair.

value.rationale: The mobility examination documents that the member can no longer toilet or prepare a meal without help due to mobility limitations.
The examination states that a rolling walker manages only 15 feet before stopping and that a walker does not resolve the limitation.
The examination states that with grip strength of 9 kg right and 7 kg left, she cannot self-propel a manual wheelchair more than 20 feet.
The home assessment dated 2026-08-28 (within 60 days before the request) confirms that doorways, turning space, and floor surfaces accommodate a power wheelchair.
The examination documents that vision is corrected to 20/30, judgement is intact, and she operated a demonstration joystick safely.
